# WebPuppet full agent brief

WebPuppet is an open source browser face puppet studio. Visitors can grant camera and optional microphone access, or start a sample performance with no camera. MediaPipe Face Landmarker runs in a WebWorker from self hosted assets. Behaviors map face and audio signals onto tagged 2D puppet layers rendered in Pixi.js.

Canonical production URL: https://webpuppet.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/vinita-byte/WebPuppet

Privacy: camera and mic data never leave the device.

## Product surface

### Studio UI (`/`)
- Character picker (new cast plus studio classics)
- Twelve scene backgrounds with animated props
- Stage frame modes: 16:9, 9:16, fill
- Capture: Start Tracking, Try without a camera, Calibrate Neutral
- Clear messages for camera denied, no camera, and tracking lost
- Tracking quality: Good, Slow, Off
- Controls panel for hold and toggle triggers
- Behaviors toggles
- SVG character idea prompts for outside authors
- Pixi viewport
- Timeline with keyframe markers, record, play, clear, loop
- Character package export/import (.webpuppet.zip with puppet.json; prefer SVG layer assets, PNG supported)
- Record video take of the Pixi stage (+ mic when available); download MOV or MP4 via on device ffmpeg.wasm
- Video takes are memory only and cleared on Clear, tab close, or session dispose
- Autosave of settings and last keyframe recording to IndexedDB (video is never persisted)

### Agent discovery files
- `/llms.txt`
- `/llms-full.txt`
- `/sitemap.xml`
- `/robots.txt`
- `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json`

## Architecture map

```
src/
  puppets/             Character definitions, layer tags, swap sets, triggers, physics, zip export
  services/vision/     MediaPipe worker (self hosted), demo tracker, landmark buffers
  services/audio/      Mic analyser and viseme calculator
  services/behaviors/  Modular puppet drivers
  components/viewport/ Pixi canvas and PuppetRig
  components/timeline/ Keyframe record and playback
  components/studio/   Character picker, controls, capture shell
  store/               Zustand stores
  lib/persistence.ts   IndexedDB autosave
public/mediapipe/      Self hosted WASM and face_landmarker.task
```

## Local development

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000. Use Start Tracking or Try without a camera.
